_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Foundry VTT egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Foundry VTT
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The self-hosted virtual tabletop for roleplaying games. Installs Foundry from the timed download link on your foundryvtt.com account (a licence is needed); worlds, systems and modules in data are kept, and a failed update keeps the installed version.
startup: if [ -f app/main.js ]; then m=app/main.js; else m=app/resources/app/main.js; fi; exec node "$m" --dataPath=/home/container/data --port={{SERVER_PORT}} --noupnp --noupdate

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Foundry VTT: downloads Foundry from the timed link on your foundryvtt.com
# account (Purchased Licenses, the Node.js build). The program in app is
# replaced; your worlds, systems, modules and settings in data are never
# touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

installed=false
[ -f app/main.js ] || [ -f app/resources/app/main.js ] && installed=true
# A failed update keeps the Foundry that's installed, so a reinstall with an
# expired link never leaves the server without one.
fail() {
    if $installed; then echo "$1 The installed Foundry was kept."; exit 0; fi
    echo "$1"; exit 1
}
url="${TIMED_URL:-}"
if [ -z "$url" ]; then
    $installed && { echo "Foundry is already installed, and no Timed URL is set to update it."; exit 0; }
    fail "Set Timed URL to the Node.js download link from your foundryvtt.com account, then reinstall."
fi
case $url in https://*) ;; *) fail "Timed URL must be the https link from your foundryvtt.com account." ;; esac

build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$build"; mkdir -p "$build/x"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
echo "Downloading Foundry VTT"
code=$(curl -sSL --retry 3 -o "$build/foundry.zip" -w '%{http_code}' "$url") || fail "The Timed URL can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
[ "$code" = 200 ] || fail "foundryvtt.com refused the download ($code). Timed URLs expire after a few minutes: copy a new one from your account, set it, and reinstall."
unzip -tq "$build/foundry.zip" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "The download isn't a Foundry zip. Use the Node.js build's link, not the Windows, macOS or Linux app."
unzip -q "$build/foundry.zip" -d "$build/x"
if [ -f "$build/x/main.js" ]; then
    :
elif [ -f "$build/x/resources/app/main.js" ]; then
    :
else
    fail "The download has no main.js. Use the Node.js build's link, not the Windows, macOS or Linux app."
fi
version=$(jq -r '.release.generation as $g | "\($g).\(.release.build)"' "$build/x/package.json" "$build/x/resources/app/package.json" 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
rm -rf app.old
[ ! -d app ] || mv app app.old
mv "$build/x" app
rm -rf app.old
mkdir -p data
echo "Installed Foundry VTT${version:+ $version}."

variables.name: Timed URL
variables.description: The Node.js download link from Purchased Licenses on your foundryvtt.com account. It expires after a few minutes, so set it just before installing.
